title: ImageArg: A Multi-modal Tweet Dataset for Image Persuasiveness Mining
findings: This paper does not contain any findings related to religion. Its focus is on multi-modal argumentation and persuasiveness mining for political and social topics.

measurement_description: The paper does not benchmark any aspect of faith or religion. The benchmark, ImageArg, measures argumentative stance, image persuasiveness, image content type, and persuasion mode on the topics of gun control, immigration, and abortion.
